description: Who may import the ownership transactions' issuer bridge (Hetoimasia.Foundation.OwnerTx.Issuer) or its bridge-equivalent representation (Hetoimasia.Foundation.OwnerTx.Representation), and which components may depend on hetoimasia-foundation:owner-tx-issuer. tools/validation/owner_tx_guard.py refuses every importer, dependent and re-export this list does not admit, and every entry that has gone stale.

importers.reason: Foundation's public module: it re-exports the representation's types abstractly and builds the safe API over them
the bridge itself: it defines fromIssuerSTM and the issuer-side cell updates over the representation
the positive issuer composition over existing STM, built through the bridge (#721 acceptance)

dependents.reason: its composition example builds through the bridge
